insights.summary: Metalic Technoforge, a Rajkot maker of closed-die forged and machined parts (rings, ball studs, gears, gear blanks) for auto, tractor and industrial OEMs, listed on NSE Emerge on 28 Jul 2026 after a ₹49.96 Cr fresh issue at ₹77. FY26 revenue rose 28% to ₹95.5 Cr, EBITDA margin was 23.0% and PAT ₹12.4 Cr; exports were 35% (Germany alone 21%). It has held no call, so the only forward plans are in the prospectus: ₹30.8 Cr of IPO money for a new forging unit and upgrades in FY27, lifting capacity from 6,800 to 8,800 tonnes a year by 31 Mar 2028, and ₹6.7 Cr to repay loans. On 25 Sep 2026 the board also approved leasing premises in Pune for another plant, which the prospectus did not mention.

tone.quote: During FY 2025-26, our Company was is operating at 90.22% level of capacity utilization, which reflects strong demand from its existing customers.

red_flags.text: Top customer is 23% of revenue and the top ten 65% (FY26).
Order book was only ₹27.6 Cr at 30 Jun 2026, about three months of sales.
Inventory days rose to 257 and the cash cycle to 183 days in FY26; operating cash flow was negative (Screener).
No earnings call or presentation since listing; first results (H1 FY27) due by mid-Nov 2026.

business_snapshot.customers: Domestic and overseas OEMs of cars, tractors, commercial vehicles, farm, hydraulic and construction equipment; top ten are 65% of revenue
